newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Liebscher sees room for repo rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Liebscher sees room for repo rate cut.

text.p: Austrian central bank president Klaus Liebscher said there was room for a downward move in the country's securities repurchase rate.
"There have been voices in Germany over the past few days saying the interest rate low has been reached - I take note of that but I still see room in the repo rate," Liebscher told reporters.
The Austrian central bank cut its repo rate to 3.00 percent from 3.2 percent on September 2. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
